rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the physical surface of the Earth.

example.english: The ground is still wet after the rain.
example.jyutping: lok6 jyun4 jyu5 dei6 min6 zung6 mei6 gon1

rows.jyutping: fat6 A lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to describe grounding a child by making them stay home.

example.english: I’m going to ground my son tomorrow and not let him go out.
example.traditional: 我聽日要罰阿仔留喺屋企，唔准佢出街。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 fat6 aa3 zai2 lau4 hai2 uk1 kei2 m4 zeon2 keoi5 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this when bad weather or another problem suspends an aircraft or flights.

example.english: The airline will ground all flights because the storm is too strong.
example.traditional: 暴風雨太勁，航空公司宣布停飛。
example.jyutping: bou6 fung1 jyu5 taai3 ging6 hong4 hung1 gung1 si1 syun1 bou3 ting4 fei1

rows.note: Use this when “ground” means soil or earth that plants and animals are in.

example.english: This flower needs to be planted in the ground.
example.traditional: 呢盆花要種喺泥土入面。
example.jyutping: ni1 pun4 faa1 jiu3 zung3 hai2 nai4 tou2 jap6 min6

rows.note: Use this when teaching someone the basic principles or introductory skills of a subject.

example.english: I’ll ground you in photography by first teaching you how to use a camera.
example.traditional: 我教你入門，先學識點樣用部相機。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gaau3 nei5 jap6 mun4 sin1 hok6 sik1 dim2 joeng2 jung6 bou6 soeng2 gei1

rows.note: Use this for the shape and features of an area of terrain.

example.english: The ground here is rugged, so drive carefully.
example.traditional: 呢區地形崎嶇，揸車要小心。
example.jyutping: ni1 keoi1 dei6 jing4 kei1 keoi1 zaa1 ce1 jiu3 siu2 sam1

rows.note: Use this for an abstract basis or for evidence and justification offered as grounds, not for a physical foundation.

example.english: This report gives us good ground to postpone it.
example.traditional: 根據呢份報告，我哋有充分理由延期。
example.jyutping: gan1 geoi3 ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 dei6 jau5 cung1 fan1 lei5 jau4 jin4 kei4

rows.note: Use this for calming or refocusing yourself, especially before or during meditation.

example.english: I do a few minutes of breathing exercises first to ground myself, then meditate.
example.traditional: 我先做幾分鐘呼吸練習，定一定神，再打坐。
example.jyutping: ngo5 sin1 zou6 gei2 fan1 zung1 fu1 kap1 lin6 zaap6 ding6 jat1 ding6 san4 zoi3 daa2 co5
